svg.text: Three role-optimised interfaces — Citizen · Volunteer · Coordinator War Room
What do you need help with?
Coordinator — War Room Dashboard (React · Google Maps · Real-time)
All three interfaces share one design language — minimal, high-contrast, works on Android 6+ on 2G networks
Citizen: 30-second report flow · Volunteer: one-tap accept + Maps nav · Coordinator: full real-time war room
Problem statement alignment: Citizen app replaces paper surveys · War room shows "biggest problems clearly" · Volunteer app enables "quick matching to specific tasks"
